# Code of conduct

Be respectful. This project is a small, maintainer-run language-learning app, and everyone who
opens an issue or a pull request is expected to:

- be kind and patient, especially with people who are still learning a language,
- keep discussion about the work, not the person,
- accept that the maintainer decides what goes into the project.

Harassment, insults and discrimination are not tolerated. Comments that break these rules may be
removed, and the people who write them may be blocked from the repository.

To report a problem, contact the maintainer through GitHub (a private message on
https://github.com/Kalmi91, or a report on the offending comment).
